purpose: Teach: 魅せ/お粗末/下品/愕然/幾分/すわっ/ふみ/成り行き

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の新メニューでお客様を魅せようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's bring in new menu items that really impress our customers.
lines.style: Warm, collaborative opening. Gentle lean-in tone. Speaking as someone who sees potential. Slight lift at the end—an invitation, not an instruction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お粗末な接客にならないよう気を付けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I want to make sure we're giving every customer the service they deserve.
lines.style: Thoughtful, self-aware. Quiet conviction without self-criticism. A gentle standard set for both of them. Steady breath, no rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、隣のお客様の下品な言葉に困ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I noticed that customer earlier seemed bothered by the language at the next table.
lines.style: Observant and gentle. Not accusatory—just noticing what others might have missed. Soft concern underneath. Slow delivery, like thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、売上を見て愕然としたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You looked pretty shocked when you checked the sales figures today.
lines.style: Dry but not unkind. Light, knowing tone—acknowledging a shared reality without dwelling on it. A small wry smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、最近お客様が幾分少ないね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Customer numbers have been down lately, haven't they.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Not a complaint, more a thought spoken aloud. Slight trailing-off, like she's wondering the same thing. Reflective pause.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、長くすわってご本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was here for hours, just reading and staying put.
lines.style: Noticing tone. Warm toward the customer. A small smile—not judgment, but recognition of something quiet and genuine. Gentle, unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ふみ慣れたお店だって仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you hear? That customer called this place their favorite spot, like a real home.
lines.style: Pleased, with quiet pride. Slight brightening on the realization. Not loud, but genuinely moved by the compliment. Warm close.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店の成り行きを応援して下さってるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer really does believe in this place, doesn't she. They're rooting for us.
lines.style: Tender and grounded. Voice softens slightly. Recognition of loyalty and care. Slow, deliberate delivery—letting the moment land. Gentle fadeout.
